# spurious-winch: a right-button resize moves the held pane's neighbours too,
# by ResizeVisual, and a workspace switch mid-gesture left the cancel to retile
# the other workspace. The cancel put back the held pane only, so the
# neighbours kept a rectangle their guests were never told, and the attach sync
# then resized their PTYs. Reproduces on Linux.
sidebar
press 38 0 2
motion 0 0 2
workspace 0
press 0 0 1
attach
